title: Minuta 2025-06-17
summary: The minutes of the June meeting show a unanimous hold at 5%, but the Council considered a 25bp cut to 4.75% and all members agreed the TPM should approach its neutral range in the coming quarters; the timing of the first cut was framed as depending mostly on 'tactical-communicational' factors. Some councillors argued a cut at this meeting would not disrupt markets since a near-term cut was already priced, and the hold prevailed mainly because the very recent Iran-Israel escalation made it prudent to wait, with one councillor citing the risk of an oil spike hitting expectations. Inflation was seen in line with projections, core lower than expected, expectations at 3% and no excess second-round effects. Versus the April-meeting minutes, where a cut was also on the table but the Council stressed the need to accumulate information and some members still worried about high inflation and cost shocks, the debate has moved to when, not whether, to cut. The minutes read more dovish than the same-day communique: the cut was a live option and the hold is essentially a one-meeting tactical delay.

key_quotes.quote: De este modo, se consideraron dos opciones para esta Reunión: (i) mantener la TPM en 5%; (ii) reducirla en 25 puntos base, hasta 4,75%.
key_quotes.context: A 25bp cut was a live option

key_quotes.quote: Hubo acuerdo en que, de concretarse el escenario central del IPoM de junio, el momento en que la TPM comenzaría a aproximarse a su rango de valores neutrales dependía en mayor grado de factores tácticocomunicacionales.
key_quotes.context: Timing of the first cut is tactical, not a question of direction

key_quotes.quote: Por ello, estimaban que un recorte en esta Reunión no debería generar mayores disrupciones en las variables financieras.
key_quotes.context: Some councillors saw no obstacle to cutting now

key_quotes.quote: Todos los Consejeros concordaron en que, en un ambiente incierto, mantener era la decisión más adecuada, siempre que se señalara con claridad que, de concretarse el escenario central del IPoM de junio, en los próximos trimestres la TPM iría aproximándose a su rango de valores neutrales.
key_quotes.context: Hold conditioned on clearly signalling cuts ahead
